summary: ptracemusl's step, copy, poll, sigwait and entry rows on x86-64, each booted alone from a probe built with PTRACE_DEBUG_ENTRY, with faults in system-call stepping and debug exception delivery; the sigwait fault fails only here

argv: ARCH=x86_64 exec sh tests/proofs/ptrace.sh rows ${WORK} step copy poll sigwait entry

faults.name: step
faults.summary: PT_STEP taken out of the test at a system call's exit, so that a step over a system call runs on

lines: syscall step ran the next instruction or lost its result

faults.name: sigwait
faults.summary: the post of a pending debug hit taken out before sigtimedwait looks at the pending signals

lines: watched sigwait did not take SIGTRAP with TRAP_HWBKPT
